Why bugs feel impossible

A bug feels impossible when one of your assumptions is wrong. Here are some categories of wrong assumption I keep running into.

1. The thing you didn't think was running, is running

A scheduled job. A retry queue. Look once for what you expect; look again for what you don't.

$ ps aux | grep tap

I have rescued a lot of debugging sessions with this exact incantation.
